description: Elegance and Exclusivity near Paris – High-End Stays & Professional EventsWelcome to this exceptional place of 345 m2 on 4 levels located a few minutes from Paris. This mansion, completely refurbished in 2023, retains its original charm with the modern layout and design of a villa. It is ideal for a refined getaway for individuals or prestigious professional events.The spaceThe manor house includes 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a large kitchen equipped with dining table, a large living room with dining room under glass roof, an office area. The spaces are modular to accommodate professional events.Outside, 160 m2 of landscaped garden with swimming pool, petanque court, ping pong table, dining table and garden furniture. Parking spaces are available inside the venue.FOR UNFORGETTABLE SPECIAL STAYSImmerse yourself in a world of luxury and serenity. This villa is designed for discerning individuals looking for comfort and privacy. Parties are forbidden, but everything is designed for a high-end stay in peace.- A refined and spacious setting- Elegant and comfortable rooms- A private outdoor area attached to a park- High speed WiFi, modern equipmentA perfect setting to recharge your batteries discreetly, at the gates of Paris.FOR PROFESSIONAL EVENTS This unique space is also available for professional projects:- Photo & video shoots- Seminars & business meetings- Brand launches & press events- Audiovisual productionsWith great natural light, tasteful decor and an adaptable setting, this place adapts to all professional settings and requirements.Just minutes from Paris, with easy access and customized services. Contact us for an exclusive and personalized experience!ALL SPECIAL EVENTS ARE NOT ALLOWED IN THIS PLACE (PARTIES, BIRTHDAYS, BAPTISMS, ETC.).
